XB Blank richiede il plugin XB attivo: s: XB Blank needs the XB plugin active: without it, the templates show nothing.
Tema di compatibilità: Fondamenta ne pre: Compatibility theme: Fondamenta takes its place, with the same templates. It stays for the sites that still use it.
Fondamenta prende il posto di XB Blank,: Fondamenta takes the place of XB Blank, with the same templates. When you activate it, the templates and parts you customized on this site move to Fondamenta.
Installala da Aspetto → Temi → Aggiungi: Install it from Appearance → Themes → Add theme → Upload theme, with the fondamenta-….zip file of the same release as the plugin.
